messages:
Maya Patel: quick sync re: Kairos onboarding — seeing periodic latency spikes during their nightly imports (lots of long-context batches). I ran a quick tail analysis, p99 up ~1.2s higher vs baseline.
Priya Rao: thanks, did you capture sample traces? any obvious kv-cache misses or very long seq lengths?
Maya Patel: yes — attaching short excerpt in thread (see below). most requests are seq_len ~2-3k, a minority ~8-12k. cache hit rate acceptable but bursts when they backfill.
Liam Chen: tagging infra — @Priya any suggested immediate mitigations that don't require a model upload?
Priya Rao: two low-friction options:
  1) quantize serving instance to int8 for their route (should reduce token latency and GPU memory pressure)
  2) route long-context/low-QPS imports to a dedicated pool with a slightly smaller model variant (gptx-medium) and keep interactive queries on gptx-large.
Maya Patel: proposal: enable int8 quant profile + add routing rule: imports -> dedicated-pool between 02:00-06:00 local (their heavy window). fallback to hosted if dedicated full.
Liam Chen: sounds good. capacity note: dedicated-pool needs a warmup policy (pre-spin 2 GPUs 15m before window) otherwise first bursts may suffer. I can add autoscale rule.
Maya Patel: can you draft the routing config? I can share with Kairos in our enablement call tomorrow.
Priya Rao: here's a quick routing snippet you can paste into Console -> Routes:
```json
{"match": {"path": "/v1/generate","meta.user_role": "importer"}, "route": {"pool": "kairos-dedicated", "time_window": "02:00-06:00", "fallback": "hosted-us"}, "transform": {"model_override": "gptx-medium", "quant_profile": "int8-stable"}}
```
Maya Patel: perfect, I’ll send that. also capturing a note for renewal-risk: Kairos asked about predictable latency for SLA; if we don’t act they'll flag this in quarterly review. putting this as an enablement objective + perf followup.
Evan Gold: (Kairos) saw the message — appreciate the proactive approach. priority is keeping imports reliable. int8 sounds safe if it preserves output quality. can we test on a small subset first? :thumbsup:
Priya Rao: absolutely — canary plan: route 5% of import traffic to int8 + gptx-medium for 24h, compare latency, token cost, and a short quality eval (5k prompts).
Liam Chen: I'll add the pre-spin autoscale and cap burst to avoid noisy neighbor issues.
Maya Patel: ops-bot — create follow-up task and attach perf dashboard for Kairos imports
ops-bot: Task created: CS-2357 "Kairos import routing + int8 canary" — https://console.redwood.ai/tasks/CS-2357. Dashboards: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/kairos-imports
Maya Patel: next steps: (1) Priya implements route + quant profile as draft (2) Liam sets autoscale/pre-spin (3) run 5% canary for 24h, collect metrics and small eval (4) enablement call tomorrow 11:00 PT to review results & get customer buy-in.
Evan Gold: 11:00 PT works for us. we'll have our data engineer on the call.
Priya Rao: I'll drop the draft route into the shared doc and flag for review.
Maya Patel: thanks team — capturing this as a proactive perf rec in their account playbook and adding a renewal note so AMs know it's been addressed.
Evan Gold: appreciated — helps us feel confident about renewal.
Maya Patel: closing loop: I'll post results in this thread after the 24h canary. :white_check_mark:
